notes.title: 1.4.0.0305.32 Update
notes.notes:
We are pleased to release a major update for [b]THE DAWNING CLOCKS OF TIME REMAKE.[/b]

This major upgrade to the newer version of the game engine fixes bugs, improves performance and lays the future groundwork for the upcoming [i]Content Update 1.[/i]

Lighting and details in the game have been also significantly improved, and many quality of life code tweaks have been made to the game.

We will release further information regarding the Content Update as development and testing progresses.

notes.title: 1.2.0.0130.31 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]This important patch fixes issues reported to us by players, and improvements based on feedback for THE DAWNING CLOCKS OF TIME REMAKE.[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed Chariot being invisible in Vita Base when starting the first mission to Aether. This was caused by a [i]race condition. [/i]
[*]Fixed save point being stuck in floor in Sven's room by moving it just outside by the door, preventing clipping through the floor upon reloading. Due to the nature of the pathfinding, it is recommended to save outside Vita Base in the future. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2744390/discussions/0/595139573830423265/]Visit this link to patch your save file if you have encountered this softlock already.[/url]
[*]Improved FPS in Vita Base by optimizing culling distance.
[*]Removed uneeded graphic downscaling left over from the Nintendo Switch port.
[*]Fixed an issue installing the game on macOS.
[/list]

[i] A race condition can arise in software when a computer program has multiple code paths that are executing at the same time. If the multiple code paths take a different amount of time than expected, they can finish in a different order than expected, which can cause software bugs due to unanticipated behavior.[/i]

notes.title: Digital Rights Management Update
notes.notes:
Due to efforts to combat recenty piracy attempts, Spacefarer R&D are including Digital Rights Management in The Dawning Clocks of Time Remake. We have every right to protect the integrity and IP of our video game software.

[b]What the DRM does do;[/b]
-Upon every launch of the game, it checks with Steam that the game is authorised and owned by the player. If authenticated successfully, the game will launch as usual. This takes a second or two, but it's usually instant. As soon as the game launches, the DRM exits.
-Notify the user if the check fails, and will not launch the game if the check fails.
-Provides executable level tampering protection, modification and prevents cracking the software and introducing potential security threats.
[b]
What the DRM does NOT do;[/b]
-Collect any player information
-Report back or 'phone home'
-Cause any bugs or performance issues.
-Modify anything on your PC.
-Use any kind of Anti-Cheat, device driver or kernel level space.
-Impose any kind of time restriction or require a constant connection to the internet to continue playing.

In the future, all updates to the Steam edition of The Dawning Clocks of Time Remake and future software products from Spacefarer on Steam will include the Spacefarer DRM. It is our own in-house solution that protects from executable modification and tampering. You can be rest-assured that releases that contain the DRM are the genuine software from us and not from unauthorised redistrubuters.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Demo Update #16
notes.notes:
We are glad you are enjoying this Steam Next Fest, and in celebration we have a big demo update for you all. This update changes and improves upon the game in general.

Here is some specifics of this update;

[b]New[/b]
-We've added animated interaction icons that appear when encountering actionable objects, instead of a static sprite before.
-We've added an animated loading screen when entering new areas that require longer load times, instead of showing a black screen not indicating progress. With this, we've placed useful tips that appear.
-We've restored beta behaviour that was missing from the game. When first appearing from the portal, Sven would appear in front. We've changed this behaviour, and Sven will now walk out of the portal and forwards.
-We've updated all NPC character animations.

[b]Bug Fixes / General Improvements[/b]

-We've fixed navigation mesh bugs that could cause clipping or phasing through certain objects.
-We've fixed a frame delay bug on the Statis Zones and finalised it's sound effect when using.
-We've fixed frame skipping on video cutscenes. They will now appear smoothly.
-We've fixed lag on Title Cards that could occur.
-We'ved fixed Irvine's voice volume and quality.
-We've fixed a bug where Combat Mode help icons would randomly appear white.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Demo Update #15
notes.notes:
Thank you to Steam players who discovered the demo during the ongoing Steam Next Fest, we've made the following changes to the DEMO VERSION of The Dawning Clocks of Time Remake;

-We've reduced the demo installation size down from 5GB to 2GB.
-We've greatly improved load speeds and game engine performance.
-We've added a sound effect when interacting with a Statis Zone (Save point)
-Soft locks with Statis Zones has now been fixed.
-We've fixed a bug where Sven's feet would sometimes clip through the floor. This was especially apparent in the Maine area.
-Sven's model will now properly raise to the correct floor level to stop additional clipping.
-We've updated Sven's animations to be more fluid and polished than before.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Demo Update #14
notes.notes:
We've made some welcome changes to the DEMO VERSION of THE DAWNING CLOCKS OF TIME REMAKE during the Steam Next Fest. Due to this, we've changed the scheduling of our live broadcast to be later during the event week. We will announce our Broadcast once we've decided on the timing.

For the demo, we've made the following changes and bug fixes-

-The Hotel Room was too dark before, we've improved it's lighting.
-We've fixed a frame delay when entering battles that was occuring due to an error in streaming data. Battles will now start instantly instead of there being a pause.
-We've fixed the Statis Zone disappearing when saving in the Alpha Centauri System.
-We've fixed a bug with Storage containers looping it's exit state.
-We've fixed performance bugs with certain cameras.
-We've fixed navigation finding bugs.
-We've fixed math clamping in the battle system.
-We've fixed a bug with closing Storage Boxes.
-We've fixed a loop bug when saving games and being prompted to save again after, causing a loop. This was difficult to replicate and *MAY* still occur under certain conditions or frame timings.
-We've updated the Inventory UI with animated Dawning Rune background.
-We've rebalanced volumes of the voice overs for coherence and best quality.
-We've fixed the Equipped weapon not being able to be changed from 'Equipped' slot on Inventory.

notes.title: Demo Update #13 And Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[b]This patch and release changes / adds the following;[/b]

-We've added missing voice overs for when the Ship navigation AI speaks.
-We've optimised load times for certain scenes.
-We've fixed being able to skip dialogs when activating the pause menu. The pause menu can no longer be accessed while dialog is in process, preventing this from happening and being able to miss crucial story telling moments.
-We've fixed being able to pause the game during saving, causing a soft lock under certain conditions.

We are very happy to present the DEMO VERSION for Steam Next Fest, in which you can see a small preview of what is to come in the release version of THE DAWNING CLOCKS OF TIME REMAKE. We will be releasing the full version in September 2024. We also have a Kickstarter campaign to amplify our market effort in preparation for the full game's release on Steam and game consoles. 

[b]Make sure that you are running the DEMO VERSION on supported hardware[/b] that the minimum and / or recommended system requirements specifies for the best experience, graphical fidelity and performance. As a reminder, the game can be played on a 64bit Windows 10 / 11 operating system, along with Steam Deck hardware and supported Ubuntu versions of Linux. 

Spacefarer R&D can be reached directly by contacting as from the Community Hub for any support or feedback requests. You can also directly contact us at [url=mailto:support@spacefarergames.com]support@spacefarergames.com[/url].

We fully appreciate your support!

Enjoy playing!
-Jake, Spacefarer Research and Development

We are proud to announce the inclusion of the Active Battle System in The Dawning Clocks of Time Remake Demo! This is an early, functional preview of what is to come in the full game.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44828759/75c2156d92a4860659620ede50dd21fc2ed3f8f4.png[/img]

Depending on Sven's emotional feelings towards characters that appear in the Effect Reel Slots, bonuses such as Extra Attack Damage and time slowdown / speedup of the Dawning Rune take effect during battles. Based on luck and your experience point multiplier, this can greatly affect the outcome of battles making them much more interesting and dynamic.

The system is not feature complete yet, but we are glad the battles are heading in the right direction. You can also see damage dealt, current EXP and helpful hints on how to use combat to your advantage. You'll hear a sound effect when time has slowed or sped up, along with the Dawning Rune in the corner indicating the current flow of the battle.

As always, we welcome your feedback on helping us to deliver a truly amazing experience in September.

notes.title: Demo Version now available!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that The Dawning Clocks of Time Remake Demo is now avaliable on Steam.

This is just a small preview of the introduction segment of the game, where Sven appears on Earth in the 1950’s. You’ll be able to try out the controls, enter a few battles and explore the areas of Maine and see some of the story. The demo ends when you reach the Alpha Centauri System.

Note that the voice acting is not present in this demo but will be updated in the future once the voice work is complete.
